author: CdCSharp
name: Pangea Omni App
description: An Avalonia application for a host such as Omni: a manifest the host reads, a protocol library other applications reference, a request handler, the host's theme while connected, and tests. Runs on its own just the same.

PangeaVersion.description: Version of the Pangea packages to reference.

AppId.description: The application's PangeaAppId and the prefix of its message ids: the name, lower case.

WorkspaceFeed.description: Add the Omni workspace feed (../../feed) to nuget.config, for the protocol packages of the other applications. Turn it off outside a workspace: a local source that does not exist fails the restore.

IncludeSkill.description: Copy the Pangea agent skill into the project so AI coding agents can read it. Off by default: in an Omni workspace the skill lives once, at the workspace root, for every application. Turn it on for an application worked on outside a workspace.
